detail.name: Sān-Z: Undying Spark
detail.desc: Commemorative namecard for the limited-time event "Filmgoer Thank-You Gift."
detail.desc2:
"From that very first spark, we've blazed a path across the world — but this is nowhere near the end. As long as the fire in our chests keeps dancing, the story doesn't end."
"We hope you'll stay with us on the journey to come. Let's set off together and light up the next chapter of New Eridu!"
— Sān-Z STUDIO
